lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Nutty finds a big, big acorn. Can he open it?
lines.zh: 栗栗捡到一颗大大的橡果。他能打开吗？

lines.speaker: nutty
lines.en: Wow! Look at this big, big acorn! It's mine!
lines.zh: 哇！快看这颗大大的橡果！是我的！

lines.speaker: hazel
lines.en: I am so hungry. Can I have some, please?
lines.zh: 我好饿呀。可以分我一点吗？

lines.speaker: bun
lines.en: One, two, three! I have an orange carrot!
lines.zh: 一、二、三！我有一根橙色的胡萝卜！
